name: Oorjith Komarraju
headline: Electrical engineering and the systems around me.
description: I am Oorjith Komarraju, an Electrical Engineering student at UC San Diego with interests in robotics, embedded systems, control, and STEM education.

hero.intro: I study Electrical Engineering at UC San Diego. I am interested in robotics, embedded systems, and the connections between hardware and software.

introduction: My interest in engineering comes from being able to understand how different parts of a system affect each other. Although a mechanism, a circuit, and a program each have their own requirements, they still have to work together for the overall system to be useful. Competition robotics gave me a way to explore these connections directly. In addition, teaching and leading teams have made me consider how the same work can be explained and understood by other people.

beyond.title: My interests beyond engineering.
beyond.intro: Although engineering is a large part of what I spend my time on, I also enjoy teaching, team sports, and reading about history. These interests give me other ways to think about how people learn and work together.

items.title: Teaching and access to STEM
items.text: I founded Fremont Robotics Academy to make hands-on STEM education free and accessible. The program has served more than 100 students across 10 schools. Through this work, I have been able to connect my own interest in robotics to opportunities for other students to develop an interest in it themselves.

items.title: Sports, history, and public transit
items.text: Outside of engineering, I enjoy ultimate frisbee, soccer, and cycling. I am also interested in history and public transit because they provide a way to consider how decisions made in the past continue to affect people's lives in the present.

items.title: Embedded control
items.text: I am exploring how sensors, microcontrollers, and actuators interact, and how feedback can be used to make the behavior of a physical system more predictable.

items.title: Power distribution
items.text: I am working through how protection and connector choices affect power distribution, particularly when the same hardware needs to be used and maintained by other people.

items.title: Autonomous robotics
items.text: I am interested in how real-time control can work alongside perception, and how the decisions made at each level affect the robot's overall behavior.

personalWriting.title: Personal writing.
personalWriting.intro: Writing gives me a way to work through an idea and consider why I find it important. I am interested in the connections between what I read, what I experience, and how those things affect my understanding of the world.

contact.heading: Getting in touch
contact.intro: I am interested in engineering opportunities, research, and projects that connect hardware and software. If your work overlaps with these interests, I would be glad to learn more about it and discuss how I could contribute.
